description:
A live child's message to the parent is a parent-waking `parentMessage` event, coalesced like other packets. The child stays running.

## Background

Without this, a blocked child can only settle with prose. With this, they can ask while still live and be steered. Nudge must not say they settled.

## Success criteria

- Packet event class parentMessage; child remains in the fleet snapshot.
- Coalesced with other pending events.
- Does not use settled generic nudge.

## Test plan

- Integration: send-to-parent → one packet, child still running.
- Unit: nudge selection for parentMessage.

## Considerations

Do not implement minion_wait. If the child then idles without further tools, that is settled (separate event).
title: Wake parent on live child questions without treating them as settled
